notes: Original initializations are retained unchanged (except timestamp normalization) and synthetic forecasts fill missing issue dates.
Synthetic forecasts are retrospective reconstructions using both earlier and later WATTCH initializations. They are not independently issued historical forecasts.

Synthetic member trajectories blend lead-time-relative displacement and intensity changes between the two neighbouring original runs. All members start at reference-track position on synthetic issue date.
Reference track at issue only; no use of future reference-track positions.
Member IDs are matched across adjacent original initializations; members missing from either are excluded.
Wind values retained in original WATTCH units without conversion.
Original runs preceding the available reference track are retained, but cannot be reference-anchored without additional historical observations.
